notes: Coop moves on N and new skins. Spies: kneel under a ledge with N to give a boost (your partner presses N near you and is thrown up to the ledge), or press N while hanging from a ledge to offer a hoist. New spy skins: Venom, Spider-Man, Breacher, Viper, Ghost, Sandstorm, Lara and Obsidian; new merc skins: Metro Police, Special Forces, SWAT and Squad Commander. Pick them under Home, Skins before joining a game. Club House and Warehouse fixes (x48-x51) included.

addons.title: Coop moves on N (boost and hoist)
